title: Llogara Pass: Tirana to Albanian Riviera road trip
excerpt: Explore the dramatic Llogara Pass on a summer road trip from Tirana Airport to the Albanian Riviera, with route tips, safety advice, and rental car options.
keywords: Tirana to Albanian Riviera road trip
intro: The Albanian Riviera beckons with crystal‑clear waters and sun‑kissed villages, but the journey there is part of the adventure. Starting at Tirana Airport, the road over Llogara Pass offers breathtaking views, a touch of history, and a few practical decisions for a smooth summer drive.

sections.title: Tirana to Albanian Riviera road trip: Route Overview
sections.body: From the moment you collect your vehicle at Tirana Airport, the main coastal artery (SH4) guides you southward. After about 120 km you reach Vlorë, where the road climbs toward the Llogara Pass at over 1,000 meters. The descent continues along the Ionian coast, passing Himarë, Dhërmi, and ultimately reaching Sarandë after roughly 270 km total. The route is well signposted, with fuel stations in Vlorë and Himarë, making it a comfortable drive for most European tourists.

sections.title: Driving the Llogara Pass – What to Expect
sections.body: The historic Llogara Pass winds through pine‑covered cliffs and offers panoramic vistas of both the Adriatic and Ionian seas. The road is steep in places, with hairpin bends that can slow traffic, especially in summer when tourists stop for photos. Weather can change quickly; fog is common above 1,000 meters, so keep headlights on and maintain a safe distance. The pass is fully open to all vehicles, but if you prefer a smoother ride, consider the newer tunnel option.

sections.title: Using the Llogara Tunnel – Faster Alternative
sections.body: Opened recently, the Llogara Tunnel bypasses the most winding sections of the mountain road. It shortens travel time by about 15 minutes and provides a sheltered path during rain or fog. The tunnel is toll‑free for passenger cars, and signage directs drivers clearly from the main highway. While the tunnel speeds you past the dramatic scenery, the traditional pass remains accessible for those who want to soak in the landscape, so you can choose based on your schedule and mood.

sections.title: Key Stops and Scenic Highlights
sections.body: A few worthwhile detours enrich the journey. In Himarë, explore the castle ruins and enjoy fresh seafood at a seaside taverna. The olive‑grove climbs of Dhërmi reward a short hike with stunning sea views. Further south, the white sand of Ksamil offers a perfect beach break before the final stretch to Sarandë. Each stop is within 20–30 km of the main route, allowing you to stretch your legs without adding significant travel time.

tip.title: Pro Tip: Fuel Up Early
tip.body: Fuel stations become sparse after Vlorë, especially in the summer rush. Fill up in Vlorë before tackling the pass, and keep a spare can of fuel in the trunk for peace of mind on the longer coastal stretch toward Sarandë.

faq.question: How long does it take to drive from Tirana to the Albanian Riviera?
faq.answer: The full drive from Tirana Airport to Sarandë is about 270 km and typically takes 4.5 to 5 hours, depending on traffic, stops, and whether you use the Llogara Tunnel.

faq.question: Is the Llogara Pass road safe for tourist drivers?
faq.answer: Yes, the road is paved and well‑maintained, but it includes steep gradients and sharp bends. Drive cautiously, use low gears on climbs, and watch for fog, especially above 1,000 meters.

faq.question: Does the new Llogara Tunnel bypass the entire scenic mountain pass?
faq.answer: The tunnel bypasses the steepest, most winding sections, providing a faster, weather‑protected route. The historic pass remains fully open, so drivers can still enjoy the panoramic views if they prefer the traditional road.
